analysis:
Examined all four primary analyses and available replayed source, including changelogs, documentation patches, file metadata and the MLX submodule update. No independently supported security regression is established by the supplied evidence; documentation claims are not proof of runtime controls.
The inference.md patch at HEAD 810–815 broadens admitted video inputs to variable-frame-rate tracks indexed using nominalFrameRate. Surrounding documentation retains decoded-byte/prepared-pixel limits, reservations and exclusion of media from prefix reuse. Review the dependency implementation for finite positive rate validation, conservative token/reservation estimates, bounded decoding, cancellation and plaintext-media custody (TB-007, T-010, T-050, A-001).
The previously questioned inference.md addition is visible in the replay at HEAD 876–880: historical returned reasoning is rendered as reasoning_content, and strict tools rely on schema validation before exposure rather than constrained decoding. changelog.d/glm-openrouter-returned-reasoning.md:3–7 also documents empty arguments and expanded thinking controls while retaining conflicting/hidden-reasoning refusals. Remaining checks are whether alternate reasoning fields receive existing history/delimiter validation, every streaming and non-streaming tool-output path validates before exposure, and rendered prompt changes preserve cache identity/account isolation (T-007, T-041). The actual policy hunks and validator are not replayed, so prior descriptions cannot establish these controls.
libs/mlx-swift-lm:1 changes executable dependency code, but only commit pointers are supplied. Its implementation diff is the principal remaining security coverage gap. Replay omits nine source units; unchanged callers were not examined. No evidenced change affects socket authorization, attestation, hop encryption, billing or privileged-helper authority. The documented resident-cache tension reported in prior analysis is not established as introduced by this PR. Human review should resolve the dependency, validation and media-bound contracts before clearing the combined change.
